en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘A supplication of the man for his brother in his absence would cause the sustenance to flow and repel misfortunes’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
A man’s prayer for his brother (in belief) in his absence increases his sustenance and repulses misfortune.”
